en.headline: Customs seize four suspected endangered turtles in US parcel at airport
en.dek: Officers found the live animals inside a package declared as a toy gift box; the case has been passed to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department.
body: Hong Kong Customs today seized four live turtles of suspected scheduled endangered species at Hong Kong International Airport. The animals, with an estimated market value of about HK$4,000, were found inside a parcel that arrived from the United States and was declared as a toy gift box.
Customs officers intercepted the package through risk assessment. The case has been handed over to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department for follow-up action.

Under the Protection of Endangered Species of Animals and Plants Ordinance, importing or possessing specimens of endangered species without proper authorisation is an offence. A conviction can bring a maximum fine of HK$10 million and 10 years' imprisonment, with the specimens forfeited.
Customs reminded the public that suspected smuggling can be reported to its 24-hour hotline 182 8080.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲四隻懷疑瀕危活龜 包裹由美國進口
zh.dek: 人員在一件報稱為玩具禮盒的包裹內發現四隻活龜，估計市值約四千元，案件已轉交漁護署。
body: 香港海關今日在香港國際機場檢獲四隻懷疑受管制瀕危物種的活龜，估計市值約四千元。這批活龜藏於一件由美國進口、報稱為玩具禮盒的包裹內。
海關人員透過風險評估截查有關包裹後發現該批活龜，案件已轉交漁農自然護理署跟進。
根據《保護瀕危動植物物種條例》，任何人如非按照條例規定進出口或管有瀕危物種，即屬違法。一經定罪，最高可被判罰款一千萬元及監禁十年，有關物品亦會被充公。
海關提醒市民，如發現懷疑走私活動，可致電24小時熱線182 8080舉報。
